messages:
tess: opened a focused PR to add a compatibility matrix and a C# SDK snippet for model_variant pinning + embedding reindex guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/634
omar: thanks! can we call out the difference between model_alias and model_version explicitly? some customers assumed alias pins forever and hit regressions.
tess: added a tiny decision table and example text: 'use model_version to pin, model_variant to select quantized runtime, use model_alias only for soft pointers.'
rita: please add a C# snippet — platform teams asked for it. also include a short note on embedding dimension changes when switching variants.
tess: added C# snippet (sync & async) and a checklist entry: verify embedding dims -> re-index -> sanity-check thresholds. snippet:
```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_KEY"));
var res = client.Generate(new GenerateParams { Model = "zephyrx-7b", ModelVariant = "q4_1", Input = "Hello" });
Console.WriteLine(res.Text);
```
ops: small infra note: Dedicated autoscale can cause a brief capacity gap for heavy models; added a line suggesting pre-warming and a sample autoscale_policy snippet.
omar: link-bot flagged a broken anchor: /docs/runtime#fallback -> 404. looks like runtime#fallback-policies now. can you update cross-links?
link-bot: Anchor check: /docs/catalog#supported-models -> 404; suggested /docs/catalog#available-models.
tess: thanks, fixed both anchors and searched repo for any other runtime#fallback references. replaced them and pushed commit.
rita: compatibility matrix looks good but add a short row for "embedding dim change" with remediation steps and impact (re-index + cosine recalibration).
tess: added that row and a small pseudo-code example for client-side shard stitching. also added a note about not changing shard_count mid-ingest.
omar: one more: include a tiny bench note for zephyrx-7b on A100 vs A10 so readers set expectations. infra gave quick numbers: p50 A100=15 tok/s, p95 A10=5 tok/s. added as indicative.
tess: merged editorial replies into PR and asked for two approvals. build preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/634 (build 8019) :white_check_mark:
rita: i'll review wording and approve. nice to have the C# snippet.
ops: LGTM from infra after the autoscale note.
tess: thanks all — will merge once approvals are in. ping me if you want the snippets in another language or more bench rows. :rocket:
